changelog:
Initial release of automation-workflows-moss skill

- Provides a comprehensive playbook for solopreneurs to automate repetitive tasks and save time.
- Covers automation opportunity identification, workflow design, tool selection (Zapier, Make, n8n), testing, and maintenance.
- Step-by-step guidance: from identifying what to automate, through designing and building workflows, to ongoing monitoring and improvement.
- Includes practical checklists, tool comparison tables, real-world examples, and troubleshooting tips.
- Offers advanced ideas for client onboarding and content distribution automations.
